notes.title: Devlog #7 - last days before premiere!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

The premiere of the Tales of Tomorrow experiment is just a few days away and we want to share with you what’s happening on our side. First of all, we would like to thank all the playtesters that shared with us feedback about our game and pointed out some bugs. You are awesome! You helped us a lot and your help is appreciated!

Right now we are doing final touches for the graphics, fixing bugs in AR.I.A’s software and working on implementing new localizations. During the launch day we should have english, polish, german, french, spanish, russian, ukrainian and simplified chinese. We believe it should allow you to enjoy the experience on the SSV KNOSSOS more closely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36173973/993d559c1ca83a1da6d7f6b751c314472e1641d7.png[/img]

On friday at 16:00 CEST we will be hosting a live stream with the developer where you will be able to hear what was inspiration for the project, how did it change from the prototype to the final game, take a look at the game itself and talk a little about the sci fi genre in general. If that’s something that interests you - join us. We intend to give away some game keys to the participants of the stream!

Now we are focused to deliver to you the best Tales of Tomorrow: Experiment experience there is. Hope you enjoy it. 

See you on the SSV KNOSSOS!

Cheers,
Duality Games Team

notes.title: Devlog #6 - A.R.I.A has a new voice!
notes.content:
AR.I.A is (except the Player) the most important character in the game. So it was very important to us that her voice is very well made, and adapted to what we wanted to achieve. First iterations of her voice were generated on the computer through voice generating software and then edited to have more computer-like sound. It was great and fitted the game fine, but we still believed that it needed to be more alive and acted out, though recorded by a living human. That’s how we came in contact with Sammi  Price. As she says about herself: 

[i]Sammi Price is an Australian-born, Wisconsin-raised, and New York City based actor, voiceover artist, and writer. They have performed across countless New York City stages as well as regionally, and are a member of the Actor's Equity Association. Sammi studied acting at The American Academy of Dramatic Arts Acting Conservatory in Manhattan, NY. They are the founder of 'Sammi Price Voice', providing voiceovers for commercial, audio book, character animation, film/television, video games, and more. They have collaborated with companies such as L’Oreal, The World Health Organization, 104.9 FM, and of course a favorite- AR.I.A! Sammi is also a spoken-word artist, having performed their poetry centering on human right activism in venues and universities across the country. They are absolutely thrilled to work with the Duality Games team.[/i]

Visit her page: http://www.sammiprice.com/

And see for yourself, how her voice perfectly fits the game: 

[previewyoutube=tJ3obiPnCRw;full][/previewyoutube]



We are extremely excited about this!

DualityGames Team

notes.title: Tales of Tomorrow: Experiment Devlog # 5
notes.content:
Hello,

this time is not the AR.I.A speaking (it’s short for Artificial Intelligence Administrator). As we are getting closer to announcing the release date there are three things we would like to talk about. First of all - state of development. So, we are very pleased to say that we are now focusing on bugixes, localisations and general polish. I’m not saying it’s perfect - we still have some work to do, but it’s getting very close to the place, where it’s a real pleasure to play it. As for the pleasure - you will play the game - you will see. It's a bit ironic ;) So, we are super excited on our side. 

From the more game related point of view, we would like to talk today a bit about the tools that you will use in game, to perform different tasks. Tools are stored in the Storage part of the Station. You are free to take them as you need, but at once you can only carry 2 of them. Secondly, at the end of every day it is checked if you have returned all the tools to the storage. It is important for Station maintenance to keep them in order. So better remember to put them in place. 

There are 5 tools:

[b]Gravitation Lifter[/b]

Used to carry heavy equipment it will allow you to carry elements that you are normally not able to pick up. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36173973/adc0faed4572135900c614831c2acd41d8399bdb.jpg[/img]

[b]Hand Held Drill[/b]

Versatile tool used to unscrew everything that can be unscrewed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36173973/80138c299fec3ef8bff06a393b3837c9844fb501.jpg[/img]

[b]Laser Knife[/b]

It will be cut with plasma to pieces that were welded together. Also used in some tasks with more entertaining value. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36173973/587865591c0e26c8cf88b1b5537c7f216b2688b8.jpg[/img]

[b]Wrench[/b]

Sometimes a wrench is only a wrench. In space there are some valves that need to be adjusted, so you can use a simple tool like this. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36173973/d49daa25d0ec5be6b53d98b9d08cfe29f0cc16ed.jpg[/img]

[b]Flashlight[/b]

Some places are darker than others, and your trusty flashlight will help you in those places. Always good to carry it with you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36173973/f23b687b25741414baa97921f7bb62b2efa21284.jpg[/img]

So, use the tools only in the way the AR.I.A instructed you to, and don’t ever try to do anything else with them. EVER. 

And the third thing. We wanted to update some steampage materials, so here it is. We are getting closer! Hope you enjoyed it!

Best,

Duality Games Team

notes.title: Tales of Tomorrow: Experiment - devlog #4 [teaser]
notes.content:
[i][previewyoutube=Q4PkAtUUKJE;full][/previewyoutube]
Dear space Explorers,

I need to warn you. I thought, just like you, that Tales of Tomorrow: Experiment is a simple game where you can enjoy the views, cheat an AI, and easily escape from the spaceship controlled by AR.I.A. That's a lie! Indeed, I've succeeded, but it cost me almost a life.
[list]
[*] First, I didn't even notice when I started to complete all the tasks given to me by AR.I.A. She was such convincing...
[*] Second, when I realized I'm stuck on the spaceship forever, I started to figure out how to escape. It's not easy when your food rations and stamina are limited, observed and examined by artificial intelligence.
[*] Third, I thought I'm not gonna encounter anything worse than tyrant AI. I didn't know everything about the spaceship earlier. And about the others...
[/list]Just remember, play the 'game' at your own risk. And first, read the warnings below. Good luck!
- Anonymous Astronaut[/i]

3 things you should know about Tales Of Tomorrow: Experiment:

1. You are on the space station controlled by AI - AR.I.A. 🤖
2. Obey every command and you will be rewarded. 🏆
Disobey and you will be punished. 🩸

notes.title: Tales of Tomorrow: Experiment - Devlog #1
notes.content:
Imagine waking up in a strange, alien place. You have no idea who you are and how you got here. Computer sounds in the background are the only sounds that go through the empty halls of what seems to be a space station. Looking through the window confirms your suspicions. An endless ocean of black emptiness and only one planet far, far away. Too far to even think about it as a place you could try to get. You are all alone. Suddenly, all the screens you thought are not functional are lighting up with dimmed green light. The text shows on them:

HELLO. MY NAME IS AR.IA. WELCOME TO SSV KNOSSOS. PLEASE COMPLY WITH THE INSTRUCTIONS.

That's how your nightmare begins. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36173973/7d714f9d4f409d4b2774b2911411e8c3ed70df57.png[/img]

ToT is a short-story psychological thriller about being stranded on a space station with an AI. Who programmed it and what for is a mystery. What’s important is that it gives you different tasks and rewards you according to your performance. Don’t even think about failing its expectations - it can only end badly. 

Will you be the one that challenges the status quo? Or you will fail, over and over again? Time will tell. 

Hope you are ready.

[b]The development progress[/b]

Currently, the development process is moving forward. Most of the core mechanics are in place and the core loop seems to work as intended. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36173973/3c994a6bed027d5f2a2ba702eb07f4ccf4d3ed1d.png[/img]

The aim is to start internal tests as soon as possible, to be able to tweak all the time-related values, so they are challenging but not too much. 

The difficulty curve is a topic for a whole other devlog. Graphic wise with every week new elements are being added and polished. We need to keep the sci-fi look and feel, but also keep the graphics and framerate on a high level. 

We will try to post more and more information about the project.

Cheers!

[i]Duality Team[/i]
